title: Lanthanide-containing clusters for catalytic water splitting and CO2 conversion
claim: Among isostructural trinuclear Ln3-MOFs, cycloaddition activity increases as the lanthanide radius decreases in the order Y > Er > Tb.
explanation: Han’s 12-connected hcp Ln3–BDC and Ln3–NDC frameworks are credited with dense Lewis-acid sites. At 60 °C and 1 MPa for 12 h, Y3–BDC reached 95%, Er3–BDC 91%, and Tb3–BDC 89%, with the same Y > Er > Tb order for the NDC series, explicitly tied to atomic radii Y < Er < Tb.
scope: Trinuclear lanthanide-cluster MOFs with BDC or NDC linkers for CO2/epoxide cycloaddition.
conditions: 60 °C, 1 MPa CO2, 12 h; Y3–BDC TON 543 in Table 3.
caveats: The radius–activity correlation is for these isomorphic series, not a general ranking of all LnCC carbonate catalysts.
